back.headline: The spec is the memory your agent doesn’t have.
blurb: AI agents write code faster than any team. They also forget every decision when the session ends, and the result is software that demos well and breaks in production.

Spec-Driven Development fixes the input, not the model. You write requirements, design, and tasks before the code, approve each at a gate, and let the agent execute against a contract it can’t forget.
points: Requirements in EARS format, a design the agent can follow, tasks sized for one session
Approval gates that stop vibe coding before it reaches main
TaskFlow Pro, built from scratch, spec by spec
Spec templates and agent skills, open on GitHub
How SDD compares to GitHub Spec Kit and Kiro, and how teams adopt it
back.bio: Felipe Fontoura has shipped software that couldn’t fail: for 20M customers, for aircraft, for satellites. Then 13 production apps in 70 days, solo, with AI agents. Now he brings that discipline to companies putting AI into production.
